name: Lanbaoshi Ban de Beihai Wangxiang Shaonü
original_name: 蓝宝石般的被害妄想少女
source:
A strange letter came to the girl's hand, pointing to a vicious robbery and murder in Qinshan Port City more than a decade ago. Li Meiyuan, a 17-year-old female high school student, lives in depression and delusion all the time. She almost excludes everything around her.

[i]The blue-diamond Damsel in distress[/i] is a new style of very brainstorming adventure game, you need to complete all the content of the previous chapter to unlock the new plot. The process of finding the truth of a case is full of confusion and various difficult reasoning challenges. You need to have certain clues to get the truth accurately. You need to go into various scenes of time to show your reasoning ability. Combining with the information described in various figures, you can find the correct answer. Each chapter has a wonderful inside. Allow you to challenge, constantly explore all kinds of strange cases around Li Meiyuan, incarnate detective step by step reasoning to get the right clues to guide the plot forward.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/970510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
女孩收到一封奇怪的信，指向十多年前秦山港城發生的一起惡性搶劫殺人案。17歲的女高中生李美源一直生活在憂鬱與妄想中，幾乎將周圍的一切拒之門外。

[i]藍寶石般的被害妄想少女[/i]是一款全新風格、極其燒腦的冒險遊戲。你需要完成前一章的全部內容，才能解鎖新的劇情。尋找案件真相的過程充滿困惑與各種艱難的推理挑戰，需要掌握特定線索才能準確揭開真相。你必須進入不同的時間場景，展現自己的推理能力；結合各個人物提供的資訊，找出正確答案。每章都有精彩內情，讓你不斷挑戰、探索李美源身邊的各種奇案，一步步化身偵探，用正確線索推動劇情。

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/970510/]Steam[/url]]
